$comment: Dated aliases of sf-tabs for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split (the old detail from the element's adapter), host-attribute (no shim).

aliases.note: the old detail adds component, tagName and template, which §8 takes out of the new one: the element's detail adapter makes it

aliases.section: §3.1 (a name the component writes carries its prefix); R193 DP-11
aliases.note: written beside data-sf-tab-index on each tab for one minor (1.2.x) and dropped in 1.3.0: a page selector [data-tab] caught the tabs' own buttons (the dropdown-panels prototype hid tab 0 with pane 0); read data-sf-tab-index
